_README: FROZEN a11y baseline — the recorded-deviation ceiling enforced by
Semantics: pages.<slug>.<axe-rule-id> = the MAXIMUM number of serious-impact
nodes that rule may produce on that page. Measured > ceiling  => CI FAILS.
A serious rule absent from a page's map has ceiling 0 => its first node FAILS.
critical-impact violations are never baselineable; any critical FAILS.
moderate/minor are reported, not gated (unchanged policy).
Every number here is an ADJUDICATED deviation, not a convenience. Raising a
ceiling or adding a rule is a product-owner decision recorded in
Lowering a ceiling after a real fix is expected: CI prints the tightened map
